title: Crashes and the crash-to-battery-damage link in the core
goal: A crash marks the part damaged, can spend a spare, and battery damage lands on the battery's record
acceptance: The drone_crashes data and its operations (record a crash in one transaction: part marked damaged, a new or used spare spent when named, crash row written; get, list by drone, category or position, last crash for a part) move into src/fpv-core, behaviour unchanged

The battery-damage link (NERV's handleFleetChat battery branch: a damage note on the battery found by pack number and series, ambiguous or missing packs refused) becomes a plain core function on the F-005 battery core; NERV's chat phrase parsing stays in NERV
Tests cover the transaction rollback paths and the damage link with invented batteries and drones
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
A behaviour difference from NERV's FPV pack is recorded and goes to the owner before it lands

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: about 120 lines of crash code, the battery-note link and their cases from test/fleet.test.ts and test/fleet-chat.test.ts. Not a measurement.
